label: Pipelining versus retiming
subgoals: Distinguish behavior-preserving retiming from latency-changing pipelining
Add k registers to every input-to-output path
Retime to distribute the added registers through the logic

label: Loops limit pipelining
subgoals: Keep each loop's register count fixed
Bound the period by loop delay divided by loop registers
Restrict pure pipelining to feed-forward logic

label: Diminishing returns
subgoals: Account for clock-to-q, setup and skew in every stage
Expect uneven stages because node delays cannot be split
Weigh throughput against clock power, area and latency
